errors.text_span: The image displays two donut charts side by side
errors.evidence: The reference describes these as pie charts (with inner and outer slices), not donut charts. They are nested/layered pie charts with 6 inner slices and 15 outer slices each.
The description fails to mention that each chart has two layers: 6 main inner slices and 15 outer sub-category slices. This nested/hierarchical structure is a key visual feature of the charts.
The description does not clarify that the numerical values represent percentages (%), which is mentioned in the reference description.

In the AttentionInfluence chart, 'Teaching & resources' (15%) is a sub-category of 'Education', not a standalone segment at the same level as 'Education'. The description treats inner and outer slices as equivalent.

errors.text_span: followed by "Teaching & resources" (17), "Science & technology education" (19), and "Health & Medicine" (19). Other segments include "History & Society" (19)
errors.evidence: The description lists sub-categories and main categories as if they are at the same hierarchical level. Teaching & resources and Science & technology education are sub-categories of Education, while History & Society and Health & Medicine are main categories.
The reference mentions that the AttentionInfluence chart is missing the 'Fin & Law' main category (3%) which is present in the reference but not mentioned in the machine description.

errors.text_span: the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart includes a small "..." segment indicating additional, unlisted categories
errors.evidence: The reference does not mention any '...' segment in the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart. This appears to be hallucinated content.

The reference mentions that the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart is missing the 'Fin & Law' or 'Policy' category that appears in AttentionInfluence, and only has 'Manage' (1%) with no 'Policy' sub-category. The machine description does not mention the absence of 'Fin & Law' in the FineWeb-Edu chart.

errors.text_span: Other notable segments include "Science & technology education" (10)
errors.evidence: In the AttentionInfluence chart, the reference lists 'Science & technology education' as 10%, but it is a sub-category of 'Education', not a standalone notable segment at the top level.

The reference specifies color coding for each segment (e.g., Blue for Fin & Law, brown for Tech & Engineering, Orange for History & Society, etc.). The machine description only vaguely mentions 'a similar color scheme' without detail.
The reference lists 'materials' (pink, 2%) as a sub-category under Science in the AttentionInfluence chart, but the machine description does not clarify which category it belongs to or its color.

The reference notes there is no separate legend and that labels are placed inside the sections. The machine description does not mention that labels are inside the slices (it says 'labels pointing to each segment' which suggests external labels).
The reference states 'all slices are labeled inside the sections', not with external pointing labels.
The reference mentions that in AttentionInfluence, 'Infor tech' (brown, 5%) and 'Historical review' (orange, 7%) are present as sub-categories, but the machine description omits these.
The reference mentions 'Medical' (light blue, 6%), 'Nutrition' (light blue, 5%) sub-categories in AttentionInfluence chart, which are omitted from the machine description.
